checks.proposed_rule:
problem: A reference file can silently differ from the documented original.
implementation: Before analysis, compare SHA-256; if different, require a measured temporal-alignment test against stored derived data and record the offset; never mix frame indices between encodes.
use_when: Any reference re-supplied after its first documentation.
avoid_when: Byte-identical source.
checks.acceptance_test: Owner confirms the origin of reference-runs/apple-music/source.MP4 or supplies the original 74301c7f... file; next reference rerun records hash check + alignment before any measurement.
